pairs.why: A's rover fills the card nearly edge to edge like the real taxi, ship and suitcase, while B's smaller rover leaves a large empty ground area.
A's target and bear are slightly larger and sit upright in the frame like the real hero group, but B is almost identical in scale and margins.
A's fins are a little larger and more diagonal, closer to the real card's occupancy, though both keep similar margins.
A's calculator is tilted more strongly, with top and bottom margins of about 60 px like the real card, while B sits more upright.
A fills the card width and height with the DJ deck and headphones as the real card does, while B is smaller with more empty orange space.
The real glass fills almost the full card height; A's glass is large and close to that, while B's is small with lots of empty background.
B's kit is a little taller and its top cymbal sits about 83 px from the top, closer to the real card's tight top margin than A's 108 px.
Both topiaries have the same width, height and tight top margin as the real card, so composition gives no reason to prefer one.
